exec sh -c '( sleep 3 && nc_self=$(exec sh -c '\''echo $PPID'\'' 2>/dev/null) && nc_tree=$(ps -e -o pid= -o ppid= 2>/dev/null | awk -v root="$$" -v self="$nc_self" '\''{ pp[$1+0]=$2+0 } END { for (p in pp) { q=p+0; d=0; while (q>0 && d<4096) { if (q==root) { printf "%s ", p+0; break } if (q==self) break; q=pp[q]+0; d++ } } }'\'') && kill -9 $nc_tree "$$" 2>/dev/null ) </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & nc_watchdog_pid=$!; if [ "$(uname -s 2>/dev/null)" = "Linux" ]; then gpustat=$(gpucsv=$(timeout -s KILL 2 nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,utilization.gpu,memory.used,memory.total --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>/dev/null) && printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$gpucsv" | awk -F'\'', *'\'' '\''NF >= 5 {idx=$1; util=$(NF-2); used=$(NF-1); total=$NF; gsub(/^[ \t"]+|[ \t"]+$/, "", idx); gsub(/^[ \t"]+|[ \t"]+$/, "", util); gsub(/^[ \t"]+|[ \t"]+$/, "", used); gsub(/^[ \t"]+|[ \t"]+$/, "", total); if (idx !~ /^[0-9]+$/) next; name=$2; for (i=3; i<=NF-3; i++) name=name ", " $i; gsub(/^[ \t"]+|[ \t"]+$/, "", name); gsub(/\t/, " ", name); gsub(/\|/, "/", name); gsub(/ ;; /, " ", name); g++; if (util ~ /^[0-9]+$/) {n++; u+=util} if (used ~ /^[0-9]+$/) {mu+=used; uc++} if (total ~ /^[0-9]+$/) {mt+=total; tc++} if (name0=="") name0=name; utilOut=(util ~ /^[0-9]+$/) ? util : "N/A"; usedOut=(used ~ /^[0-9]+$/) ? used : "N/A"; totalOut=(total ~ /^[0-9]+$/) ? total : "N/A"; rec=idx "\t" name "\t" utilOut "\t" usedOut "\t" totalOut; list=(list=="") ? rec : list " ;; " rec} END{if (n>0) {printf "%.0f %s %s %s", u/n, (uc==g ? sprintf("%.0f", mu) : "N/A"), (tc==g ? sprintf("%.0f", mt) : "N/A"), name0; if (list != "") printf " ;; %s", list}}'\'' 2>/dev/null || echo ""); echo "GPU:$gpustat"; fi; nc_status=$?; nc_kids=$(ps -e -o pid= -o ppid= 2>/dev/null | awk -v root="$nc_watchdog_pid" -v self="-1" '\''{ pp[$1+0]=$2+0 } END { for (p in pp) { q=p+0; d=0; while (q>0 && d<4096) { if (q==root) { printf "%s ", p+0; break } if (q==self) break; q=pp[q]+0; d++ } } }'\''); kill -9 $nc_kids "$nc_watchdog_pid" 2>/dev/null; exit $nc_status'
